title: Partition String
summary: Given a string s, create segments by starting at index 0 and extending the segment until a unique substring is formed.
statement: Given a string s, create segments by starting at index 0 and extending the segment until a unique substring is formed. Add this unique segment to the list, mark it as seen, and start a new segment from the next index. Continue until the end of s, then return an array of these segments.
constraints: Extend each segment until its value has not appeared as a completed segment.
hints: Extend a buffer until it is absent from a set.
Record an unseen buffer and reset it.
This makes every segment end at the earliest required position.
editorial: This makes every segment end at the earliest required position.

tests.explanation: Repeated candidates are extended until each completed segment is new.
The segments are a and aa.
